  • Method Details

    • getAllRuleSets

      List<TradingCalendarRuleSet> getAllRuleSets()
      Returns every rule set for the overview table, with the transient display fields filled in.
      Returns:
      the rule sets ordered by name

    • getRuleSetOptions

      List<ValueKeyHtmlSelectOptions> getRuleSetOptions()
      Returns the rule sets as select options for the stock exchange dialog.
      Returns:
      options with the rule set id as value and its name as key, ordered by name

    • getRuleSetIdByMic

      Map<String,Integer> getRuleSetIdByMic()
      Returns the rule sets that carry a MIC, keyed by that MIC. The stock exchange dialog uses it to preselect the matching rule set as soon as a MIC is chosen, so the user does not have to look it up.
      Returns:
      map from MIC to rule set id

    • getResolvedRuleSet

      HolidayRuleSet getResolvedRuleSet(Integer idTradingCalendarRuleSet)
      Resolves a rule set to its effective form, with the rules of the set it extends prepended.
      Parameters:
      idTradingCalendarRuleSet - the rule set to resolve
      Returns:
      the effective rule set, ready to produce closures

    • previewClosures

      SortedMap<String,String> previewClosures(Integer idTradingCalendarRuleSet, String ruleYaml, int year)
      Resolves a rule set and returns the closures of one year together with the name of the rule that produced each one. Drives the preview in the rule editor, so the user sees the effect of a rule before saving it.
      Parameters:
      idTradingCalendarRuleSet - the rule set to evaluate
      ruleYaml - unsaved YAML to evaluate instead of the persisted text, may be null
      year - the year for which the closures are wanted
      Returns:
      map from closure date to rule name, in ascending date order

    • assertDeletable

      void assertDeletable(Integer idTradingCalendarRuleSet)
      Refuses the deletion of a rule set that is still referenced, either by a stock exchange whose trading calendar it produces or by another rule set that extends it. Deleting it would leave the exchange without a calendar source or the extending set without its inherited rules.
      Parameters:
      idTradingCalendarRuleSet - the rule set about to be deleted

    • validateRuleYaml

      List<String> validateRuleYaml(String ruleYaml)
      Validates the YAML of a rule set without saving it.
      Parameters:
      ruleYaml - the YAML text to check
      Returns:
      the validation messages, empty when the YAML is valid
